out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink next to 3-compartment sink being used to store trays.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS instructed PIC that the hand sink is for handwashing only. PIC removed the trays from the hand sink.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the service area is slow to drain. EHS discussed with PIC repairing the sink drain/plumbing to ensure proper drainage
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS discussed with PIC repairing the sink drain/plumbing to ensure proper drainage.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked French fries at 78F in the baskets on the trays next to cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS discussed with PIC that cooked French fries (TCS) should be held at 135F and above, or held using Time as Public Health Control for not more than 4 hours. PIC agreed to use TPHC for the cooked French fries and to maintain documentation for the initial temperature and the time the french fries is discarded. EHS provided a copy of TPHC agreement to PIC. PIC discarded French fries that were held for more than 4 hours,

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sliced American cheese at 51F, unsalted butter at 53F, raw hotdogs at 51F in 3 DR UPR True refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded sliced American cheese, unsalted butter and raw hotdogs. PIC relocated other TCS food items, which had been stored in the refrigerator for no more than 4 hours, to another unit maintaining the proper temperature.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: Observed raw shell eggs in 3 DR UPR True refrigerator at 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC discarded raw shells eggs.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 DR UPR True refrigerator at the back kitchen at 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discontinued use of unit until repairs completed. PIC contacted technician during the inspection.

violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: PIC provided hand soap at kitchen hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sliced American yellow cheese at 52F, sliced Provolone cheese at 52F, precooked commercial hot dogs at 52F in 3 DR UPR True refrigerator at kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all aforementioned TCS food items. PIC moved all TCS food items that had been in that unit for not more than 4 hours to the proper working refrigeration unit.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Hamburger, Cheeseburger, Turkey burger.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Please update the menu to include the required disclosure and reminder. PIC provided temporary corrective action in a format of table tent at the front of a restaurant. PIC will send proof of the updated menu to EHS.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: PIC provided paper towels at kitchen handwashing sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw chicken stored above sliced provolone cheese in 2 DRW stacked cooler under grill.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw chicken below all ready to eat food.
